llm_response.reason: The page displays a near-perfect copy of the Google homepage on a subdomain ('yell.conen.sa.com') unrelated to Google, fulfilling scam characteristic #16: mimicking legitimate company names, logos, and website designs. There is no evidence this is an official Google domain.
